changelog: Multi-Step Parent Account Setup: Username, Password, and Email with instant availability checking.
12-Word Master Recovery Key: One-tap Copy Phrase and Download Key with Android share sheet support.
Compact In-App Update Card: Top-of-screen update notification with direct download & install.
Exact Alarms & Schedule Automation: Full Android 12-14+ support with auto-rescheduling.
Multi-OEM Anti-Tamper: Intercepts uninstallation across Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and Huawei.
Resolved Infinite Loading: Added timeout protection and responsive scrolling across all setup dialogs.
